local_review.review_comment: Verified the contribution is scoped to com.azure:azure-storage-blob:12.29.0 and uses only the accepted metadata format. The public, version-agnostic tests exercise Azure Blob public APIs from a separate test package, assert observable behavior, enforce 60-second test bounds and 10-second I/O timeouts, and contain no scaffold placeholder, native-image skip, reflection shortcut, visibility bypass, or unsupported runtime class definition. The reported dynamic-access result is the valid 0/0 no-calls case, so percentage and entry-count mismatch gates do not apply. I also challenged the native build flags: removing them reproduced dependency-originated SLF4J image-heap failures; retaining those flags then reproduced the Base64Variant failure; adding Base64Variant then reproduced the PaddingReadBehaviour failure. This confirms the original four-class build-time initialization list is necessary and narrowly scoped. Local index gates were green, and the exact Forge finalizer completed all three native lanes, metadata/style checks, generated-test validation, and statistics generation without changing the publishable tree.
